text:
anya: Heads-up: we got a DSAR delete run that left ~dozen records in limbo. Erasure service marked tombstone_pending but KMS logs show 'resource not found' for key versions. Anyone familiar with this error pattern?

vik: saw that in staging once after key rotation where new key ring name didn't match the mapping table. Error looked like: 
```
WARN 2026-03-20T08:12:04Z keystore: decrypt error: cryptoKeyVersion not found key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/tenant-rot/cryptoKeys/ephem v=2
```

hannah: do we have a mapping for old->new key versions in the erasure backfill? I thought rotations are transparent.

anya: rotation is supposed to be transparent but the service stores key resourceName at time of encryption. Backfill reads resourceName and tries decrypt. If the key was destroyed or rotated into a new resourceName we need version mapping or a rewrap path.

infra-bot: Config change detected: 2026-03-19T23:45:12Z terraform apply by svc:infra-cicd@github-actions altering kms: remove-to-default-keyring for project redwood-prod.

legal-eve: from privacy side: we must confirm scope: which subject_request_ids did not reach final deleted state and whether any plaintext exposure occurred. Please log request ids and timestamp windows.

ops-sam: running an export of erasure ledger for rows with status in [tombstone_pending, tombstone_partial] and last_updated between 2026-03-19T23:00:00Z and 2026-03-20T09:00:00Z.

vik: quick mitigation idea: add a shim in erasure service to detect cryptoKeyVersion not found and call key-lookup service which can consult rotation history. If found, re-invoke decrypt with the correct resourceName.

anya: for immediate unblock, can infra re-create a compatible alias resource pointing to the current key so decrypts succeed? That has fewer blast-radius concerns than granting broader SA perms.

ops-sam: I can create an alias/cryptoKey with same resourceName to avoid changing application logic. Will coordinate with infra change window.

hannah: also flagging an audit gap: our audit exporter only surfaces SetIamPolicy and CryptoKey versions but not per-request decrypt success/failure correlated to erasure job ids. We need a cross-reference field in logs.

infra-bot: note: previous IAM rotation removed roles from serviceAccount:erasure-worker@redwood-prod around 2026-03-19T22:50:00Z. binding removed: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter.

anya: oh that's probably why some decrypts failed earlier and then later failed with resource not found once infra reworked keys. Two concurrent changes bit us.

ops-sam: export done. found 14 subject_request_ids. dumping secure list to restricted drive and DMing legal.

legal-eve: thanks. we need a short customer-facing note if any DSARs are affected. Draft language: "We detected a failed internal erasure step due to a key configuration change; no evidence of data exposure; we have resumed erasure and will provide confirmation when complete." Happy to edit after teams confirm no exposures.

vik: I'm starting a controlled backfill run with additional key-version lookup logic enabled. job id: erasure-retry-1769. It will attempt rewrap paths for records that initially failed.

erasure-bot: erasure-retry-1769 status: queued (workers=4). pending 14 items.

anya: follow-up items: 1) infra to add alias mapping for compatibility (ops-sam + infra), 2) short-term role restoration if needed to re-run decrypts (infra), 3) add key-rotation metadata and mapping service (platform), 4) add correlation id in decrypt logs for future audits (engineering), 5) customer note draft (legal).

ops-sam: alias created at 1769876690. starting retry run.

erasure-bot: erasure-retry-1769 progress: 14/14 items attempted, 12 succeeded, 2 failed -> status tombstone_partial. failures show 'decryption key destroyed' for two legacy archives.

hannah: for the two destroyed keys we need to escalate to legal & product. If keys truly destroyed, we can't recover ciphertext; must document and confirm whether partial erasure acceptable under DSAR rules.

legal-eve: acknowledged. please prepare an evidence package: ledger export, KMS audit entries, job logs, and a statement of what data is unrecoverable. We'll need to advise the requesters and regulatory team.

anya: opening postmortem ticket now and will attach artifacts. Also creating a follow-up to prevent future partial states: erasure must mark records as 'requires_manual_review' rather than tombstone_partial after N retries and enable a dead-letter queue for manual ops.

vik: adding an integration test that simulates key rotations and destroyed versions so backfill logic handles all branches.

legal-eve: please cc me on the ticket. We'll draft notifications if needed. Also confirm no plaintext logged anywhere; ops, can you run a grep across ephemeral workers for any debug prints?

ops-sam: doing full scan of worker logs between 2026-03-19T22:00:00Z and 2026-03-20T10:00:00Z. returning zero incidents of plaintext. will include checksums and grep outputs in the evidence bundle.

anya: wrap-up: we've recovered 12/14, created alias to limit blast radius, queued two for legal review, and opened tickets for long-term key-mapping service and improved erasure observability. Closing thread when legal confirms next steps for the 2 unrecoverable items. Thanks everyone.
